# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(scDblFinder)
library(harmony)
```

# Create Seurat Object

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_1_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pdac_1_data, min.cells = 3, project = "PDAC tumour 1")

pdac_tumour_2_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pdac_2_data, min.cells = 3, project = "PDAC tumour 2")

pdac_tumour_3_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pdac_3_data, min.cells = 3, project = "PDAC tumour 3")

pdac_tumour_4_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pdac_4_data, min.cells = 3, project = "PDAC tumour 4")

pdac_tumour_5_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pdac_5_data, min.cells = 3, project = "PDAC tumour 5")

pdac_tumour_6_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pdac_6_data, min.cells = 3, project = "PDAC tumour 6")

pdac_tumour_12_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pdac_12_data, min.cells = 3, project = "PDAC tumour 12")

pdac_tumour_13_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pdac_13_data, min.cells = 3, project = "PDAC tumour 13")

pdac_tumour_14_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pdac_14_data, min.cells = 3, project = "PDAC tumour 14")

pdac_tumour_15_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pdac_15_data, min.cells = 3, project = "PDAC tumour 15")

pdac_tumour_16_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pdac_16_data, min.cells = 3, project = "PDAC tumour 16")

rm(pdac_1_data, pdac_2_data, pdac_3_data, pdac_4_data, pdac_5_data, pdac_6_data, pdac_7_data, pdac_8_data, pdac_9_data, pdac_10_data, pdac_11a_data, pdac_11b_data, pdac_12_data, pdac_13_data, pdac_14_data, pdac_15_data, pdac_16_data)
```



# 1. QC

## % mitochondrial reads

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_1_so[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pdac_tumour_1_so, pattern = "^mt-")

pdac_tumour_2_so[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pdac_tumour_2_so, pattern = "^mt-")

pdac_tumour_3_so[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pdac_tumour_3_so, pattern = "^mt-")
```

# 3. Pre-process

```{r, include=FALSE}
all_genes_pdac_tumour_1 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_1_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_2 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_2_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_3 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_3_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_4 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_4_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_5 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_5_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_6 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_6_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_7 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_7_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_8 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_8_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_9 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_9_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_10 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_10_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_11a <- rownames(pdac_tumour_11a_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_11b <- rownames(pdac_tumour_11b_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_12 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_12_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_13 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_13_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_14 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_14_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_15 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_15_so_filtered)
all_genes_pdac_tumour_16 <- rownames(pdac_tumour_16_so_filtered)
```


## PDAC tumour 1

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_1_so_filtered_norm <- pdac_tumour_1_so_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_pdac_tumour_1) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(pdac_tumour_1_so_filtered_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_1_so_filtered_norm <- pdac_tumour_1_so_filtered_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:40) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:40)
```

# 5. Integrate PDAC tumour data sets using Harmony

## Merge
```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_1_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_2_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_3_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_4_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_5_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_6_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_7_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_8_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_9_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_10_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_11a_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_11b_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_12_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_13_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_14_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_15_singlet) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumour_16_singlet) <- "RNA"

pdac_tumours_combined <- merge(pdac_tumour_1_singlet, y = list(pdac_tumour_2_singlet, pdac_tumour_3_singlet, pdac_tumour_4_singlet, pdac_tumour_5_singlet, pdac_tumour_6_singlet, pdac_tumour_7_singlet, pdac_tumour_8_singlet, pdac_tumour_9_singlet, pdac_tumour_10_singlet, pdac_tumour_11a_singlet, pdac_tumour_11b_singlet, pdac_tumour_12_singlet, pdac_tumour_13_singlet, pdac_tumour_14_singlet, pdac_tumour_15_singlet, pdac_tumour_16_singlet))
```


## Pre-process
```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumours_combined <- NormalizeData(pdac_tumours_combined) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures() %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(pdac_tumours_combined, ndims = 50)
```


## Run harmony

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumours_combined <- RunHarmony(pdac_tumours_combined, group.by.vars = "orig.ident")

pdac_tumours_combined <- FindNeighbors(pdac_tumours_combined,reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:50) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5)

pdac_tumours_combined <- RunUMAP(pdac_tumours_combined, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:50)
```


## Order orig.idents

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumours_combined$orig.ident <- factor(
  pdac_tumours_combined$orig.ident,
  levels = c(
    "PDAC tumour 1", "PDAC tumour 2", "PDAC tumour 3",
    "PDAC tumour 4", "PDAC tumour 5", "PDAC tumour 6",
    "PDAC tumour 7", "PDAC tumour 8", "PDAC tumour 9",
    "PDAC tumour 10", "PDAC tumour 11a", "PDAC tumour 11b",
    "PDAC tumour 12", "PDAC tumour 13", "PDAC tumour 14",
    "PDAC tumour 15", "PDAC tumour 16"
  )
)
```


## Visualize integration

```{r}
Idents(pdac_tumours_combined) <- "orig.ident"

DimPlot(pdac_tumours_combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "umap1", y = "umap2") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```


## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(pdac_tumour_1_singlet, pdac_tumour_2_singlet, pdac_tumour_3_singlet, pdac_tumour_4_singlet, pdac_tumour_5_singlet, pdac_tumour_6_singlet, pdac_tumour_7_singlet, pdac_tumour_8_singlet, pdac_tumour_9_singlet, pdac_tumour_10_singlet, pdac_tumour_11a_singlet, pdac_tumour_11b_singlet, pdac_tumour_12_singlet, pdac_tumour_13_singlet, pdac_tumour_14_singlet, pdac_tumour_15_singlet, pdac_tumour_16_singlet)
```



# 6. Annotate clusters 

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumours_combined) <- "RNA"

Idents(pdac_tumours_combined) <- pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters
pdac_tumours_combined <- JoinLayers(pdac_tumours_combined, what = "all")
```


## Specify clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumours_combined_cluster_ids <- levels(pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters)

pdac_tumours_combined_cluster_labels <- c("Neutrophils", "Tumour cells", "T cells", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Tumour cells", "T cells/NK cells", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Mast cells", "Tumour cells", "CAFs", "T cells/NK cells", "T cells", "B cells", "Plasma cells", "NK cells", "NK cells", "Pancreatic cells", "Tumour cells", "Tumour cells", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Tumour cells", "Endothelial cells", "Tumour cells", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Platelets")

pdac_tumours_combined_clusters <- pdac_tumours_combined@meta.data$seurat_clusters

pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters <- pdac_tumours_combined_cluster_labels[pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters]
```


## Order clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters, levels = c("Pancreatic cells", "Tumour cells", "Endothelial cells", "CAFs", "Platelets", "Mast cells", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Neutrophils", "B cells", "Plasma cells", "T cells", "T cells/NK cells", "NK cells"))
```


## Plot to show DEGs between subclusters

```{r}
DefaultAssay(pdac_tumours_combined) <- "RNA"
Idents(pdac_tumours_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

DotPlot(object = pdac_tumours_combined, features = c(
  "AMY2A", "CPA1", "REG1A", "CTRB2", "PRSS1", # Pancreatic cells
  "MUC1", "HMGA2", "S100P", "PCNA", # Tumour-specific
  "TFF1", "KRT8", "KRT18", "KRT19", # Epithelial cells
  "CDH5", "PLVAP", "VWF", # Endothelial cells 
  "PDGFRA", "DCN", "LUM", # CAFs
  "PF4", "PPBP","TUBB1","ITGA2B", # Platelets
  "CPA3", "TPSAB1", "CLU", # Mast cells 
  "ITGAM", "CCR2", "CD14", # Monocytes
  "CD68", "CD74", "CD83", "CCL2", "CCL3", "C1QA", # Macrophages
  "S100A8", "S100A9", "ITGAX", # Neutrophils
  "MS4A1", "CD79A", "IGJ", # B cells 
  "CD3E", "CD3D", "CD4", "CD8A", "CD8B", # T cells
  "NKG7", "GZMB" # NK cells
)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1, face = "italic")) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("red", "white", "blue")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```


## Split Monocytes and Macrophages

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(pdac_tumours_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

Monocytes_macrophages <- subset(pdac_tumours_combined, idents = "Monocytes/macrophages")

Monocytes_macrophages <- NormalizeData(Monocytes_macrophages)
Monocytes_macrophages <- FindVariableFeatures(Monocytes_macrophages, nfeatures = 2000)
Monocytes_macrophages <- ScaleData(Monocytes_macrophages)
Monocytes_macrophages <- RunPCA(Monocytes_macrophages, npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(Monocytes_macrophages, ndims = 50)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
Monocytes_macrophages <- FindNeighbors(Monocytes_macrophages, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:41) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.9)

Monocytes_macrophages <- RunUMAP(Monocytes_macrophages, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:41)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(Monocytes_macrophages) <- "RNA"

Idents(Monocytes_macrophages) <- Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters
Monocytes_macrophages <- JoinLayers(Monocytes_macrophages, what = "all")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(Monocytes_macrophages) <- "seurat_clusters"

Monocytes_macrophages_cluster_labels <- c("Neutrophils", "Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils", "Macrophages", "Monocytes", "Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils", "Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Macrophages", "T cells/NK cells", "T cells/NK cells", "Macrophages", "Macrophages")

Monocytes_macrophages_clusters <- Monocytes_macrophages@meta.data$seurat_clusters

Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters <- Monocytes_macrophages_cluster_labels[Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters]
```

### Write new cluster labels back into pdac_tumours_combined

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters <- as.character(pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters)

pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters[Cells(Monocytes_macrophages)] <- 
  as.character(Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters)

pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters)

rm(Monocytes_macrophages, Monocytes_macrophages_cluster_labels, Monocytes_macrophages_clusters)
```


```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(T_NK_cells) <- "seurat_clusters"

T_NK_cells_cluster_labels <- c("T cells", "NK cells", "T cells", "T cells", "T cells", "T cells", "T cells", "NK cells", "T cells", "T cells", "NK cells", "T cells", "NK cells", "Macrophages", "Macrophages")

T_NK_cells_clusters <- T_NK_cells@meta.data$seurat_clusters

T_NK_cells$seurat_clusters <- T_NK_cells_cluster_labels[T_NK_cells$seurat_clusters]
```

### Write new cluster labels back into pdac_tumours_combined

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters <- as.character(pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters)

pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters[Cells(T_NK_cells)] <- 
  as.character(T_NK_cells$seurat_clusters)

pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters)

rm(T_NK_cells, T_NK_cells_cluster_labels, T_NK_cells_clusters)
```


## Re-order clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(pdac_tumours_combined$seurat_clusters, levels = c("Pancreatic cells", "Tumour cells", "Endothelial cells", "CAFs", "Platelets", "Mast cells", "Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils", "B cells", "Plasma cells", "T cells", "NK cells"))
```


## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(all_genes_pdac_tumour_1, all_genes_pdac_tumour_2, all_genes_pdac_tumour_3, all_genes_pdac_tumour_4, all_genes_pdac_tumour_5, all_genes_pdac_tumour_6, all_genes_pdac_tumour_7, all_genes_pdac_tumour_8, all_genes_pdac_tumour_9, all_genes_pdac_tumour_10, all_genes_pdac_tumour_11a, all_genes_pdac_tumour_11b, all_genes_pdac_tumour_12, all_genes_pdac_tumour_13, all_genes_pdac_tumour_14, all_genes_pdac_tumour_15, all_genes_pdac_tumour_16, pdac_tumours_combined_cluster_ids, pdac_tumours_combined_cluster_labels, pdac_tumours_combined_clusters)
```


## Visualize clusters

```{r}
PDAC_cluster_colours <- c(
    "Pancreatic cells"     = "#E00000",
    "Tumour cells"         = "#C0C0C0",
    "Endothelial cells"    = "#FFFF00",
    "CAFs"                 = "#7CFC00",
    "Platelets"            = "#D46A6A",
    "Mast cells"           = "#C85C8C",
    "Monocytes"            = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages"          = "#1E90FF",
    "Neutrophils"          = "#4169E1",
    "B cells"              = "#C9A2FF",
    "Plasma cells"         = "#A06BEF",
    "T cells"              = "#B44CFF",
    "NK cells"             = "#5B0E8A"
)

DimPlot(pdac_tumours_combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, cols = PDAC_cluster_colours) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "umap1", y = "umap2") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```
